newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines cuts leisure fares.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines cuts leisure fares.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc Monday it cut fares for leisure travel throughout the fall and early winter for travel throughout the United States and to Latin America and the Caribbean.
For U.S. travel, fares range from $89 to $219 each way.
Sale tickets must be purchased at least 14 days in advance, require round-trip travel and a Saturday-night stay, the company said.
The reduced fares apply for travel from October 28 to February 13, excluding peak holiday periods, the company said.
Delta Air Lines Inc spokesman Bill Berry said it would be responding competitively to the Continental sale.
USAir Group Inc said it would match Continental's lower faree.
